blocks: Table 6: This table presents results of regression analysis of NRA campaign contributions, lobbying
spending, and advertising spending on the proportion of pro-gun bills proposed in Congress for each year
that data is available. This test generated three statistically significant results in which p < 0.02. These
were the regressions of (1) campaign contributions on the count of pro-gun bills, (2) lobbying
expenditures on the count of pro-gun bills where lobbying data was measured biannually, and (3)
lobbying expenditures on the count of anti-gun bills where the lobbying data was measured quarterly.
These tests are marked with an asterisk (*).
